assessments.name: CUA-S1-FORMS
assessments.why: A narrow option scorer could reduce general-LLM work when mapping extracted document values into forms. This is a sandbox test candidate, not a production recommendation.
assessments.access: Model card documents a 2.8 MB checkpoint and local loading; no hosted inference provider is listed.
assessments.cost: Self-hosting cost not measured; small checkpoint alone does not establish workflow cost.
assessments.quality: Publisher evaluation covers 196 decisions across three real forms and three PDFs; arbitrary real-world forms are not validated.
assessments.integration: Requires document/entity extraction, PyTorch, cua_s1 and a Cua Driver adapter. Estimated effort: medium.
assessments.caveats: English-centric labels; chooses only from extracted entities; no calibration guarantee. Never enable live submission during evaluation.
assessments.evidence: Publisher documentation; no independent evaluation reviewed.
assessments.next_test: Proposed: compare against current rules or an LLM on 30 synthetic forms, including missing values and look-alike fields. Measure correct field assignment, safe skips and latency; disable submit clicks.

assessments.name: Laya
assessments.why: Potential fit for routing monitoring events before calling a larger model, but the publisher's own limitations argue against deploying it as a zero-shot decision engine.
assessments.access: Downloadable checkpoints with local Python loading; a hosted API is not documented on the reviewed model card.
assessments.cost: Infrastructure and maintenance cost unknown; self-hosted does not mean cost-free.
assessments.latency: Publisher provides T4 measurements; not measured on our workflow or hardware.
assessments.quality: Publisher describes base typed-decision performance as near chance and warns that calibration and specialization are required.
assessments.integration: Python inference service callable from an automation workflow. Estimated effort: medium to high if fine-tuning is needed.
assessments.caveats: Short input limits; weak zero-shot typed decisions; language-dependent behavior; confidence can be misleading without calibration.
assessments.evidence: Publisher model card and benchmarks; no independent Laya evaluation reviewed.
assessments.next_test: Proposed: create a held-out synthetic alert-routing set; compare simple rules and the current router. Evaluate false escalations, missed critical events and calibration before any production use.

assessments.name: DAMO RADAR
assessments.why: Abdominal CT diagnosis does not match the current automation, API, coding and monitoring priorities. Keep it in the complete release timeline without spending evaluation effort.
assessments.access: Repository documents downloadable pretrained checkpoints and inference support files.
assessments.license: Apache 2.0 project license; third-party components have their own licenses.
assessments.quality: Expert-level claims are publisher claims; clinical readiness is not established by this review.
assessments.integration: Specialized medical-imaging pipeline, not a general document or dashboard model. Estimated effort: high outside its intended domain.
assessments.caveats: No clinical approval was established. Do not use for medical decisions or upload patient data in this project.
assessments.evidence: Publisher repository; no independent study assessed in this review.
assessments.next_test: No test recommended for the current project. Reassess only if an authorized medical-imaging use case is introduced.

signals.name: CUA-S1-FORMS
signals.capability_reason: Specialized mapping of extracted entities into form actions; useful only if that step is a bottleneck.
signals.cost_mechanism: May replace some general-LLM field-mapping calls with a small local scorer.
signals.cost_reason: No measured baseline, deployment cost or matched-quality comparison. Small weights do not establish lower total cost.

signals.name: Laya
signals.capability_reason: Typed decisions may fit routing or triage after specialization; zero-shot behavior is not sufficient evidence.
signals.cost_mechanism: Potential early routing before a larger model call.
signals.cost_reason: Training, calibration, serving and false-decision costs are unmeasured; no savings claim.

signals.name: DAMO RADAR
signals.capability_reason: Abdominal CT analysis is outside the default automation, coding and research profile.
signals.cost_reason: No relevant baseline workflow or authorized clinical evaluation.
